planning_gate.objective: Adopt and validate a shadow-first Loop Engineering pilot that reads Blacksmith canon and protected surfaces without changing product behavior, then permits a later A2 isolated implementation only for separately locked work already inside approved canon.
acceptance_criteria: The project profile is SHADOW-first with current effective autonomy A0_OBSERVE.
A2_EXECUTE_ISOLATED is only a post-SHADOW default and does not authorize immediate product mutation.
The A3 auto-merge allowlist remains empty and the scheduler runtime provider remains NOT_CONFIGURED.
No protected product root, Base adapter pin, workflow authority, Task3 scope, or approved game meaning changes.
The existing CI-consumed contract test passes at the exact PR head.
Unverified runtime, Android, visual, accessibility, performance, and human-play evidence remains explicitly unclaimed.
protected_behavior: Blacksmith project core and Android portrait crafting experience remain unchanged.
Crafting, enhancement, economy, probability, item UID lifecycle, save compatibility, major UX, and input meaning remain unchanged.
Task3 remains NOT_SEPARATELY_APPROVED and new product scope remains USER_DECISION_REQUIRED.
Godot persistent authoring remains behind P0_LOCAL_EXECUTOR_BOOTSTRAP and a fresh HiGodot receipt.
The Blacksmith Base v9.4.3 adapter pin and protected baseline remain unchanged.
exclusions: No writes under data/, scripts/, scenes/, assets/, addons/, or project.godot.
No new gameplay feature, Decision10, Task3 implementation, balance change, save migration, image generation, or approved-art change.
No repository workflow, ruleset, permission, secret, or external paid action change.
No scheduler, webhook, daemon, or 24/7 agent runtime installation.

ready_tasks.objective: Perform a read-only authority, open-work, protected-surface, and validation-gap readback for the next separately approved Blacksmith implementation package.

justification.problem: Phase C implementation may be decomposed incorrectly or drift into protected product scope unless the current canon, actual implementation, open work, and validation gaps are read together.
justification.evidence: Blacksmith canon permits Phase C work only inside existing approved scope while Task3 and new product scope remain separately gated.
justification.player_or_user_value: Reduces repeated technical questions and prevents autonomous work from changing the approved crafting experience, UID history, or save/UX meaning.
justification.risk_if_ignored: An agent could duplicate active work, use a stale main SHA, or turn an implementation HOW decision into an unapproved product decision.
justification.expected_outcome: A read-only SHADOW report containing justified task candidates, dependencies, resource locks, evidence requirements, defer decisions, and explicit user-decision blockers.

verification: Confirm the exact current main SHA before and after the readback.
Compare START_HERE, CURRENT_CONFIRMED_DECISIONS, ACTIVE_CONTEXT, DEVELOPMENT_GATES, ROADMAP, open PRs/branches, and actual code/data/scene/test state.
Verify that no persistent repository or external-system mutation occurs during SHADOW.
Run an independent adversarial review against protected product and governance surfaces.
